From 80714b09bc574c5b23e50264e76e6e0f78d23549 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Vladimir Kondratiev <QCA_vkondrat@QCA.qualcomm.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2015 19:10:48 +0300
Subject: [PATCH] wil6210: fix format specifier for dma_addr_t

Fix format specifier used for dma_addr_t, namely use %pad
Debug print virtual address for the same buffer as well.

Fixes: dc16427bbe65 ("wil6210: Add pmc debug mechanism memory management")
Signed-off-by: Vladimir Kondratiev <qca_vkondrat@qca.qualcomm.com>
Signed-off-by: Kalle Valo <kvalo@qca.qualcomm.com>

diff --git a/drivers/net/wireless/ath/wil6210/pmc.c b/drivers/net/wireless/ath/wil6210/pmc.c
index 3cb4f35ebd05..8a8cdc61b25b 100644
--- a/drivers/net/wireless/ath/wil6210/pmc.c
+++ b/drivers/net/wireless/ath/wil6210/pmc.c
@@ -92,9 +92,9 @@ void wil_pmc_alloc(struct wil6210_priv *wil,
 			GFP_KERNEL);
 
 	wil_dbg_misc(wil,
-		     "%s: allocated pring %p. %zd x %d = total %zd bytes\n",
+		     "%s: allocated pring %p => %pad. %zd x %d = total %zd bytes\n",
 		     __func__,
-		     (void *)pmc->pring_pa,
+		     pmc->pring_va, &pmc->pring_pa,
 		     sizeof(struct vring_tx_desc),
 		     num_descriptors,
 		     sizeof(struct vring_tx_desc) * num_descriptors);
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/net/wireless/ath/wil6210/pmc.c`**
   - The format specifier in the debug print statement has been changed from:
     ```c
     "%s: allocated pring %p. %zd x %d = total %zd bytes\n"
     ```
     to:
     ```c
     "%s: allocated pring %p => %pad. %zd x %d = total %zd bytes\n"
     ```
   - The argument passed to the debug print statement has been modified to include the virtual address (`pmc->pring_va`) and the physical address (`&pmc->pring_pa`) using the correct format specifier `%pad` for `dma_addr_t`.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The change in the format specifier is directly related to the need for correctly displaying the `dma_addr_t` type, which is crucial for debugging memory management in the context of the `wil6210` driver. By using `%pad`, the patch ensures that the physical address is printed correctly, enhancing the clarity and accuracy of debug information. This modification is part of a broader effort to improve the debug mechanism introduced in a previous commit (dc16427bbe65).

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
wil_dbg_misc(wil,
             "%s: allocated pring %p. %zd x %d = total %zd bytes\n",
             __func__,
             (void *)pmc->pring_pa,
             sizeof(struct vring_tx_desc),
             num_descriptors,
             sizeof(struct vring_tx_desc) * num_descriptors);
```
Reason:
The incorrect format specifier `%p` was used for printing the `dma_addr_t` type (`pmc->pring_pa`), which could lead to incorrect or misleading output when logging memory allocation details, making it difficult to track memory management issues.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
wil_dbg_misc(wil,
             "%s: allocated pring %p => %pad. %zd x %d = total %zd bytes\n",
             __func__,
             pmc->pring_va, &pmc->pring_pa,
             sizeof(struct vring_tx_desc),
             num_descriptors,
             sizeof(struct vring_tx_desc) * num_descriptors);
```
Reason:
The format specifier was changed to `%pad`, which is appropriate for printing `dma_addr_t` types, ensuring that the output is correct and useful for debugging memory management issues in the `wil6210` driver.
